start: A member with a followed plan 'PPL' and one other folder 'Home', on the Workout tab

user_sees: Sheet 'Where should the routine go?' with 'Your plan only changes if you pick it.'
First row 'My routines' with 'Not in your plan' (or 'Not in your plan · 2 routines')
Last row 'PPL' with 'Your plan · Up next will include it' and a tick
must_not: The plan changed before the member picks anything

steps.action: Tap 'My routines', build and save the routine
user_sees: The routine inside 'My routines'; 'PPL' and Up next unchanged
must_not: The new routine in the followed plan

start: A member on a saved routine's page

user_sees: Sheet 'Where should the copy go?' with the same rows
must_not: The copy made before a folder is picked

user_sees: The copy inside the followed plan; Up next now includes it

start: A member on a finished workout's page, or its menu in the Profile feed

must_not: A routine saved straight into the followed plan

start: A brand-new member with no folders at all

user_sees: One row 'My routines' with 'Not in your plan'
must_not: A row for a plan that does not exist

steps.action: Close the sheet with the X
must_not: A routine or folder made by closing the sheet

start: A member whose followed plan is itself an old folder named 'My Routines'

user_sees: First row 'Other routines' with 'Not in your plan'
Last row 'My Routines' with 'Your plan · Up next will include it'
must_not: Picking the first row putting the routine in the followed plan

user_sees: A folder 'Other routines' with the routine
must_not: The routine in the followed 'My Routines'

user_sees: The routine stays on this phone (and the member's own cloud copy when signed in)
